meta.name: pr-to-video
meta.description: Turn a GitHub pull request (a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or 'this PR' in a checked-out repo) into a code-change explainer video — changelog, feature reveal, fix, or refactor walkthrough built from the diff, commits, and files: the input is a code change, not a website. Not a product promo (/product-launch-video) or a no-PR topic explainer (/faceless-explainer). Unclear → /hyperframes.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把一次代码改动自动生成一条讲解视频
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你常需要向团队讲清某次代码改动做了什么
copy.tagline_en: Turn a code change into a narrated explainer video
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often need to explain what a code change did

howto.what: 把 GitHub PR 的 diff、提交和文件转成逐帧讲解视频(变更日志、新功能、修复、重构),产出 STORYBOARD.md、帧 HTML 和最终的 renders/video.mp4。
howto.when: 当你给它一个 GitHub PR——PR 链接、owner/repo#N 或检出仓库里的 “this PR” 时接管。不含 PR 的讲解需求或意图不明时,先走 /hyperframes。

say.text: 用这个 PR 做一支变更日志视频,控制在 60 秒
say.note: 时长按简报里的 length 设定
需显式传 --voice,否则用默认音色

howto.what_en: Turns a GitHub pull request's diff, commits and files into a frame-by-frame code-change explainer video, producing STORYBOARD.md, frame HTML files and a final renders/video.mp4.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you give it a GitHub PR — a PR URL, owner/repo#N, or "this PR" in a checked-out repo. Non-PR explainers or unclear intent route to /hyperframes first.

say_en.text: Turn https://github.com/acme/sdk/pull/1842 into an explainer video
say_en.note: Fetches the PR diff and drafts a frame-by-frame script

say_en.text: Make a changelog video from this PR, about 60 seconds
say_en.note: Length comes from the brief's length field

say_en.text: Use a male voice for the narration
say_en.note: Pass --voice; default is Marcia or am_michael
